t: You're on Saffron Hill, a street in Holborn, in the south eastern corner of Camden, running between Farringdon Road and Hatton Garden. The name comes from an estate where saffron once grew. It was also a ward, and the parish was St Peter, Saffron Hill, now combined with St Alban, Holborn. Charles Sabini was born here in 1889. Known as Darby, he became a gangster, called the Godfather of London's Little Italy and the king of the racecourse gangs across the south of England between the wars.
